title: 演讲里的句子
subtitle: 乔布斯在斯坦福的毕业演讲
reviewNote: 示例句组：句子凭记忆录入，待 tiger 对照演讲全文逐句核对；简单英文释义为 AI 起草，待审核。

sentences.en: You can't connect the dots looking forward; you can only connect them looking backwards.
sentences.cn: 向前看的时候，你无法把点点滴滴串起来；只有回头看，才能把它们连起来。
sentences.grammarNote: 现在分词作状语：looking forward / looking backwards

sentences.en: So you have to trust that the dots will somehow connect in your future.
sentences.cn: 所以你必须相信，这些点点滴滴在你的未来会以某种方式连起来。

segments.text: that the dots will somehow connect in your future

glosses.simpleEn: to believe that something is true or will happen
in some way that you do not know yet

sentences.en: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
sentences.cn: 你的时间有限，所以不要浪费时间活在别人的生活里。
sentences.grammarNote: waste + 名词 + 现在分词：浪费在做某事上

glosses.simpleEn: to use something badly, or to use it for nothing useful

sentences.en: Don't let the noise of others' opinions drown out your own inner voice.
sentences.cn: 不要让别人意见的噪音淹没你内心的声音。
sentences.grammarNote: let + 宾语 + 省 to 的不定式：让……做某事

segments.text: Don't let the noise of others' opinions
drown out your own inner voice

glosses.simpleEn: to be so loud that other sounds cannot be heard
inside a person, in their mind or feelings

sentences.en: Have the courage to follow your heart and intuition.
sentences.cn: 要有勇气追随你的内心和直觉。
sentences.grammarNote: 不定式作定语：the courage to do …

segments.text: to follow your heart and intuition

glosses.simpleEn: the ability to do something difficult or frightening
a feeling that you know something without thinking about it

sentences.en: I'm convinced that the only thing that kept me going was that I loved what I did.
sentences.cn: 我确信，唯一支撑我走下去的，是我热爱自己所做的事。
sentences.grammarNote: 宾语从句里套着定语从句和表语从句

segments.text: that the only thing that kept me going was that I loved what I did

glosses.simpleEn: completely sure that something is true
to not stop, and continue to do something
